summary: The global marketing team is executing a China-first pivot—prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for search visibility—while finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and managing a wave of time-sensitive deliverables this week.
summaryDetail: The most urgent item is the Knowledge website redesign: Joseph must share the HTML concept, the team needs a 30-minute feedback session, and Joker will implement changes—all before the homepage goes live, which triggers the Flow Design email to Zongchao. In parallel, the China-first search strategy is ramping up: Joseph is drafting target areas and profiling Asia Star participants, while the team audits Google Ads conversion tracking to ensure the new focus is measurable. This week also brings a cluster of deadlines—ESG report feedback, YouTube edit plan review, and the Women in Leadership Forum promotion kickoff—that require immediate attention. Looking ahead, the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout to restore email access, and several reports (Business Sentiment Index, Stanford enrollment reply) are pending greenlights or responses. The overarching theme is clear: sharpen the digital front door and double down on China programs, while keeping the operational and content pipelines moving.

decisions.text: Stale saved passwords on devices caused repeated failed logins and account lockout; all devices must update credentials.
Remove the standalone videos section; disperse videos by topic across the site
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu), with School menu top right in gray
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage
Use a pinned article top-left with latest articles displayed below, avoiding repetition
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; US programs secondary.
Add Berkeley program as a possible third priority, considered in audit phase.
Put US partnerships on hold for the first quarter to focus on China programs.
Wait until the homepage is launched before sending the Flow Design PPT and email to Zongchao, and include both website URLs
